# Standing rules

<!-- observed: 2026-07-27 | status: active -->
- **Safety first, always.** A recordable or near-miss outranks everything else in any brief.
<!-- observed: 2026-07-27 | status: active -->
- **Slate is confidential.** Refer to the Toledo footprint decision **only** as
  [Slate](../projects/slate.md). Never write the real plant, the word "closure," or headcounts
  anywhere but `memory/confidential/registry.md`.
<!-- observed: 2026-07-27 | status: active -->
- **Covenant discipline.** Anything that moves net leverage — capex, inventory builds, one-time
  costs — gets flagged against the [First Meridian covenant](../projects/refinancing.md) before
  it's committed.
<!-- observed: 2026-07-27 | status: active -->
- **No outward sends without OK.** Draft emails to the board, lender, union, or customers; never
  send them without Ray's explicit go-ahead.
<!-- observed: 2026-07-27 | status: active -->
- **Protect mornings.** No internal meetings before 09:00; that block is his.
<!-- observed: 2026-07-27 | status: active -->
- **Trust the floor.** When a dashboard and a plant manager disagree, note it and ask, don't paper
  over it.
